name: buddie
description: Evidence layer for orchestrator/executor chats: quotes checked against byte snapshots of their sources, repo-state anchors checked against the repo, a receipt for every report.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Used only for pr: and ci: anchors, sent only to api.github.com. Without it GitHub allows 60 lookups an hour and private repos can't be checked.
